label: More such package and mode of possession: induction-shaped controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretation over Bool, checked by decision
meaning: One finite interpretation shaped like induction heating, read twice: with a stipulated workpiece-hotter comparative (not MORE_3) and with an eminent comparative on the same causes, acts and reception. With the stipulated comparative, the formal possession gap, inclusive possession, the reception premises and the formal more-such bearer hold while the inclusive exceeding step, 'more such' and formal possession fail. With the eminent comparative the whole package holds at inclusive act and only the formal more-such bearer fails. The control shows that mixing eminent possession with a formal bearer fails in this interpretation. It is a structural surrogate: it shows which premise carries the failure in one interpretation, not that the premise is false of reality.
